toggle.style: UIToggle popout, Default 0, AlwaysAllowInBuildMode = true, ShowInEditor = true (AddMany into <gui/game/parts/part_toggles.rules>/PartToggles next to bs_ammo_type); shared with F4 (AvailableChoices [0,1,2]) and the missile paiol ([0..3]) per econ

choices.desc_ptbr: Míssil padrão: uma ogiva alto-explosiva por míssil. Rápido, barato (Fábrica de Mísseis) e bom para saturar defesas de ponto.
choices.desc_en: Standard missile: one high-explosive warhead each. Fast, cheap and good at saturating point defense.

choices.desc_ptbr: O portador abre antes do alvo e solta um cardume de minimísseis teleguiados (12 na Caipora, 20 na Mula) que se espalham pelas peças do inimigo. Afoga a defesa de ponto; flak de área é o contra.
choices.desc_en: The carrier opens short of the target and releases a swarm of homing mini-missiles (12 / 20) that spread over the enemy's parts. Overwhelms point defense; area flak counters it.

choices.desc_ptbr: Pulso eletromagnético: drena a bateria do escudo que atinge (o overclock do escudo não corta o dreno pela metade: nos escudos do SW o dreno entra inteiro; no escudo reforçado do jogo base perde 1/3) e, no casco, a bateria das peças em volta. Quase não faz dano ao casco.
choices.desc_en: Electromagnetic pulse: drains the battery of the shield it hits (not halved by shield overclock) and, on hull hits, the batteries around. Little hull damage.

choices.desc_ptbr: Ogiva nuclear. Míssil lento e visível: derrubado com facilidade se vier sozinho, devastador se chegar. Máximo de 2 Mulas por nave; o overclock nunca acelera a recarga.
choices.desc_en: Nuclear warhead. A slow, visible missile: easy to shoot down alone, devastating when it lands. Max 2 Mulas per ship; overclock never speeds its reload.

launch_logic.model: 1.x NGEN model B kept unchanged except the feed: per-mode magazine -> crewed autoloader (ResourceConverter) -> ready-rack latch -> rippled salvo -> reload (docs/MISSEIS_PROJETO.md section 4; tools/bsgen/launchers.py)
changes_vs_1x: family magazines (MagStorage_HE/Thermal/EMP/Nuke, vanilla missile_part_*) -> one magazine per mode: MagStorage_<i> (ResourceType = the mode's bs_msl_*), i = bs_missile_type index; ReadyRack_<i>, Autoloader_<i> (FromStorage MagStorage_<i>, FromQuantity = charges per rack unit, ToQuantity 1), ModeToggle_<i>, ModeSwitchDelay_<i>, PrefilledDelay_<i>, DryWait_<i>/DryFlush_<i>, Fire_<i>, RackFullTrigger_<i>

UsesThermal / UsesHE family toggles and the doubled AmmoConsumersOn/Off blocks disappear: each magazine belongs to exactly one mode, so its consumer is gated by ModeToggle_<i> (same ToggledComponents ID trick as guns, common.toggled_consumers)

entrada por modo: PRIMARIO = fita grudavel (launchers[].logistica.teleporte: FitaEntra_<chave> -> MagStorage_<i>, ou DosPaiois_<i> + Alimentador_<i> q por 0,1 s com fita_arma = puxa); RESERVA (rede/gemea) = FitaEntrada_<i> NetworkResourceOutput {ResourceType bs_msl_*; Categories [rafaeltessaro.bs_paiol]; AllowUncategorized false; Mode DistributeProportionallyByAvailable} + Alimentador_<i> ResourceConverter {FromStorage FitaEntrada_<i>; ToStorage MagStorage_<i>; Interval 0.1; Quantity q; OperationalToggle ModeToggle_<i>} (econ network_primary.flow; vanilla missile_launcher_thermal.rules:91-108,240-246). The belt fills the magazine with or without crew; only the AUTOLOADER needs crew (1.x rule: weapons only need crew to operate).

crew fallback kept: MagConsumer_<i> (Weapon_Supply) with ResupplyThreshold = floor(MaxResources / 2), so belt-fed launchers never create crew jobs; AlimentadaRecente Timer (1 s) drives the green belt lamp (econ)
internal stock = 5 salvos: ReadyRack_<i> = 1 salvo (units), MagStorage_<i> = 4 salvos (charges)
cook-off: one ScorchedEffects/DeathEffects pair per storage (1.x stage-4 pattern) with the capped values below; no resource-level DeathHitEffects (econ cookoff.resource_level OFF)
unchanged: deck-safe missile core (SimpleHit, FriendlyShipLow/HighCollisions false, SourcePartCollisionDelay 1.5 ticks)
overclock costs (heat per charge loaded, constant heat, vent, OverclockReset, cook-off chain)

missile_types.role: standard missile; the SW 'Concussion' peer; saturates PD by numbers (12 / 16 / 48 per salvo)
missile_types.mechanic: SimpleHit; HitOperational = [ExplosiveDamage { TotalDamage = { BaseValue = X; EffectScaleExponent = 1 }; Radius }, Impulse]; HitStructural = HitShield = &HitOperational (vanilla missile_he.rules:113-133 shape, no Friendlies)
missile_types.counterplay: PD/CIWS (single target), shields eat it at the bubble edge, armor holds explosions

missile_types.role: Sunflower/Transformers-3 swarm: opens short of the target into 12 / 20 homing minis; anti-PD saturation + damage spread over many parts
missile_types.counterplay: area flak (Tamanduá/Pororoca/vanilla flak) eats swarms; kill carriers before they open; shields catch the whole brood

missile_types.role: shield breaker + battery soft-kill; SW 'Intruder' peer; Bullet Strike parts have no battery and are immune
missile_types.counterplay: armor ExplosiveResourceDrainSink soaks the hull pulse (1000 vanilla / 1500-2250 SW per tile); ships without batteries ignore it; shoot it down

missile_types.role: late alpha strike, Mula only, max 2 Mulas per ship, NO decoys, never accelerated by overclock
missile_types.counterplay: any heavy flak or SW blaster PD kills a lone Iara (0% leak, interception_estimate); it must be masked by a salvo; slow (8.6 s to 1000 m)

cluster_sunflower.reference: Sunflower Corporation cluster (Workshop 2995534359): 2-shot carrier -> child, 'breaks into smaller missiles designed to overwhelm Point Defense', preview GIF shows >20 minis curving onto separate interior parts; original child count/fuse not public (web REPORT.json findings 'Sunflower cluster numbers' / 'preview GIF'). Transformers-3 reference unverified (web).

carrier.BURST: root group of the carrier file: { HitEffects [ { Type = SpawnBullets; Bullet = &~/CHILD; Count = N; Distance = [0.2, 1.0]; Arc = [-60d, 120d]; Spread = [-10d, 10d]; InheritVelocity = true; HealthFactor = { BaseValue = 1; EffectScaleExponent = 1 }; RandomizeTarget = true } ] MediaEffects [ petal shed + open flash + puff + 'open' sound slot ] }

TimedFuse.why: out-of-range shots still open (flight to max range 4.32 / 5.07 s)

open_triggers.Hit: HitShield / HitOperational / HitStructural = &~/BURST (an early impact still releases the swarm; on a bubble the minis spawn at the edge and spend themselves on it)

carrier.open_point: 300 m (Caipora) / 400 m (Mula) from the enemy hull = about 1.0-1.3 s of mini flight: the swarm visibly fans out and curves in (Sunflower 'opens well before impact'), but minis spend only ~1 s inside PD range; never opens over the own deck (StartDelay 1.0-1.2 s = 60-85 m out)
carrier.hp_rule: children HP pool >= carrier HP (Caipora 12 x 200 = 2400 >= 2000; Mula 20 x 250 = 5000 >= 4000): splitting never makes the salvo easier to shoot down in total HP

children.file: same folder as the carrier, ID suffix _child (kept from 1.x): rafaeltessaro.bs_msl_twin_cluster_child / rafaeltessaro.bs_msl_quad_cluster_child
children.RandomizeTarget: true on the carrier's SpawnBullets. Field exists in the 0.30.4c decompile (AW SpawnBulletsEffectRules members: Arc, Bullet, Count, Distance, EffectScale, HealthFactor, InheritVelocity, RandomizeTarget, Spread), type bool; behaviour ('each child picks a random point on the target') is INFERRED -> test T-MSL-CLUSTER; fallback variant cluster_randomize_target=off_fan
children.spread: Arc [-60d, 120d] = a 120 degree forward fan (vanilla bullet_large_overclock Arc [-40d, 80d] reads as +-40), Spread +-10 deg, Distance 0.2-1.0 tile; homing after 0.12 s pulls each mini onto its own part
children.no_magnet_no_spacing: 1.x ProximityAcceleration magnet/spacing removed by default (cost per child; RandomizeTarget does the spreading); they return in the off_fan fallback

petals.default: particles: the BURST MediaEffects shed 4 petal sprites (fxkit flipbook/streaks with art cluster_petal_m/l textures, outward 25-40 m/s, spin 360-720 deg/s, life 0.6 s, fade) - zero gameplay objects
petals.variant_bullets: cluster_petals=bullets: 4 petal shots (Sprite with Spin, DeathByLifetime 0.6, no Targetable, no hit effects) from a second SpawnBullets (Arc full circle) - the art research recommendation; only if particles look wrong
petals.true_flipbook: optional later: carrier opening flipbook (AnimatedSprite + NormalsTexture, vanilla bullet_deck.rules:156-182) - art 'body_frames', not in 2.0 scope

performance_budget.per_ship_worst_case: 2 Mulas (category limit) + Caiporas: 2 x 160 + n x 96 minis alive for ~1.3-1.5 s
performance_budget.per_mini_components: BoxPhysics, Acceleration, TargetHoming, SameShipRetarget, DeathByLifetime, Sprite body (cluster_mini, 0.5x0.19 tiles, no normals, no lights atlas), Sprite plume (additive, NOT IsLight), Targetable, SimpleHit. No particle emitter in flight, no ProximityAcceleration, no IsLight (160 lights wash white hulls).
performance_budget.fx_budget: mini impact preset 'cluster_child' <= 8 particles, no smoke, sound MaxConcurrent 6; carrier BURST <= 40 particles (1 flash, 4 petals, <= 12 puff, <= 20 sparks)
performance_budget.estimate: one Mula salvo ~ 160 x 8 x 0.5 (overlap) + 8 x 40 = ~960 live particles, the Phase B Tamanduá budget (~940)
performance_budget.lite_switch: env BS_CLUSTER_LITE=1 (generator): Count 6 / 10, child damage x2, child HP x2 (same totals, same pool rule) for weak PCs; default OFF

balance.rule: cluster sustained = ~1.10x HE of the same launcher (damage spread, fragile minis, charge costs 1.2x HE tile-s); best mode vs single-target PD (interception_estimate: Caipora vs SW blaster PD 38% leak vs HE 29%)

poraque_2.summary: Poraquê 2.0 = single-target shield drain on HitShield (ion research default) + Sobrecarga rider + hull area pulse; no gun EMP ammo exists any more (EMP lives in the PEM line and this missile)
poraque_2.HitShield: own block: ResourceDrain { ResourceType = battery; Amount = { BaseValue = D; EffectScaleExponent = 1 }; TreatShieldAsPart = true; MediaEffectsOnDrain [vanilla missile_emp sizzle/lightning/drain] } + AreaShieldStatusApplication cosmoteer.shield_overload (Radius 1, StatusDuration 4, StatusValue 0.15, MaxStatusValue 0.30, UseMaxValuesForHitShield false) + Damage d. The area pulse is NOT repeated in HitShield (ion's sketch listed it there too: that would double-count the bubble).
poraque_2.HitOperational: ExplosiveResourceDrain battery TotalDrain = drain (Caipora 4000 r10 / Mula 7500 r12), Slices 16, Filter { Ships = true; Shields = true } (no Friendlies; vanilla missile_emp.rules:145-199 shape) + Damage + structural-only ExplosiveDamage (2000 r2 / 3000 r2.5) + StatusApplication cosmoteer.disruptor_drain (3 s, 0.2) + Impulse; HitStructural = &HitOperational
poraque_2.why_single_target: ExplosiveResourceDrain is soaked by armor ExplosiveResourceDrainSink (vanilla 1000/tile, SW durasteel 1500, doonium 2250) and ResourceDrain(TreatShieldAsPart) is not halved by shield overclock (SW bubbles have no DrainResistance; vanilla reinforced overclock resists 33%) - CRITIC SPOT-VERIFY 3, ion findings
poraque_2.caps: no single launcher salvo pops a SW giga bubble (320,000): Caipora 164,800, Mula 306,400 (hard check 'emp salvo shield HP < 320000'); drain per charge <= 3000
poraque_2.overclock: autoloader / 1.2 only (1.x rule) so OC shield rate stays near the PEM line OC
poraque_2.optional_pulses: poraque_pulses=repeating: wrap the hull area pulse in Type = Repeating (Count 3, Interval 0.8, InitialDelay 0.1, RequireHitPart true) - SW-only engine type proven on 0.30.4 (SW missile_intruder.rules:129-178), default OFF
poraque_2.r1_note: J2-LOW: MediaEffectsOnDrainFactor so existe em ExplosiveResourceDrain (vanilla missile_emp.rules:163); no ResourceDrain fica so MediaEffectsOnDrain (padrao ion SW)
poraque_2.overload_switch: missiles.poraque_overload (default true, safe false): sem ele o HitShield fica ResourceDrain + Damage (J2R2-LOW)

iara.summary: nuclear missile, Mula-sem-Cabeça only, 2 per salvo (inner pods, layout torpedo2_inner), 1 Ogiva Nuclear (bs_msl_nuke) per missile, NO decoys, reload never shortened by overclock
iara.chain: two stages kept for Phase B's separation look: stage file bs_msl_quad_nuclear.rules (booster, BoxPhysics [2.0, 0.65], Speed 30, Acceleration 20, TargetHoming 90d Delay 0.3, Targetable 12000 'missile', Hit = &<warhead>/Components/Hit so an early impact still detonates) -> Deploy = DeathByLifetime { Lifetime = 1.5; FactorEffectsWith = Targetable; OnDeath { HitEffects [ SpawnBullets { Bullet = &~/WARHEAD; Count = 1; InheritVelocity = true; HealthFactor = { BaseValue = 1; EffectScaleExponent = 1 } } ] } } (vanilla missile_nuke_stage1.rules:31-50) -> warhead file bs_msl_quad_nuclear_warhead.rules (Speed 0 inherit, Acceleration 20, TargetHoming 90d, DeathByLifetime 9.5, BoxPhysics [1.6, 0.6]). The 1.x second SpawnBullets (decoys) and the file bs_msl_quad_nuclear_decoy.rules are deleted.
iara.warhead_hit: SimpleHit; HitOperational = [ExplosiveDamage { TotalDamage = { BaseValue = 175000; EffectScaleExponent = 1 }; Radius = 10; ExpandDuration = .8; ExpandStartRadius = 2; ExpandLoss = 100%; ImpulsePerNDamage = 10; NDamage = 1000; Filter { OperationalHealth = true; StructuralHealth = false } }, ExplosiveDamage { 55000; Radius = 8; Filter { OperationalHealth = false; StructuralHealth = true } }] (no Friendlies); HitStructural = &HitOperational; HitShield = the operational block only

vs_references.SW proton torpedo: 120,000 op + 80,000 struct = 200,000 per 30 s on 1x2, HP 7200, range 150 (SW proton_rocket.rules:4,67,96-181; proton_launcher.rules:113): Iara = 1.15x per missile, 1.67x HP, 6.7x range
vs_references.vanilla nuke: 200,000 op r10 + 60,000 struct r8, HP 7200, range 250 (missile_nuke_stage1.rules:2,122,141,157): Iara 0.88x per missile at 4x range

iara.look: Phase B 'unmistakable' look kept as is: art nuclear_l (stage) + nuclear_wh_l (warhead) with green band / hazard stripes / trefoil, fxkit.radiation_components (7-tile green light spinning 120 deg/s + small trefoil), plume_light_nuclear (green), smoke_nuke_160, fire_nuclear_200, launch_flash_nuclear, separation_nuclear, shot-down leak_iara + bs_nuke_ring_small, impact = vanilla nuke mushroom (missile_nuke_flash_light/flash/shockwave/hit) at MediaEffectsScale 1.45 (1.x 1.3 for r9; x10/9 for r10) + bs_nuke_ring + bs_nuke_afterglow + shake 0.5 / 1.5 s. bs_nuke_fx is now used only by the Iara (Boiúna drops its nuclear shell).

art.silhouette: Cyberpunk quad battery (ref 4) in the family style: a flat wide headless body 4.8 tiles across - an open armored collar ('neck') with a very dim ember recess where a head should be - carrying two pairs of long rectangular pods on visible hydraulic piston arms, each pod face a 3x4 cell grid (48 tips); claw blades at the pod roots, armored skirt over the ring, rear vent bay with 6 amber pips. Reads at 64 px as 'four ammo boxes around a dark collar'. ALT HEAD (user's choice): Gorjala's 'one-eyed giant' - an armored brow with ONE sensor eye in a dark recess between the pod pairs (ref 2).
art.pods: 4 rectangular pods (2 per side) on piston arms, outer pods splayed 6 deg
art.cell_grid: per pod 3 cols x 4 rows = 12, pitch 0.26 x 0.22 tile, tube radius 0.09, pitched 40 deg; heavy look = one long nose per 3-cell row; cluster look = Piranha heavy8 (2 portadores por casulo); nuclear look = inner pods capped (green band), outer pods shuttered
animations: 4 ResourceSprites per mode on one rack (RangeLow/RangeHigh per pod; one image set reused by the 4 pods)

four-beat ripple drum across the pods, per-launch flash + backblast fan (cannon_smoke_deck, RoofCannonSmoke bucket), screen shake 0.02, 0.15 thump on the last missile (TriggeredEffects on the latch turning off)

piston arms loop (turret_anim 8 frames, subtle); collar ember recess uses M['ember'] (very dim) and brightens only under overclock - total emissive area stays under the 1-2 % budget (STYLE.md §1.6); NO flame particle by default
nuclear mode: outer-pod shutters close (static sprite toggled by ModeToggle_nuclear); impact: Iara uses fxkit NUKE (Phase B), never the Boiúna (no nuclear look in 2.0)
